d:
Eshiya paisifik iknomik koopreshan yani APEC samit 18-19 navanbar ko chin ke shenjhen men huaa. is sal ki baithak ka vishay- 'bilding ain eshiya-paisifik kamyuniti tu prospar tugedar' tha. hairan karne vali bat hai ki eshiya ki tisri sabse bari arthavyavastha hone ke bavjud bharat APEC se bahar hai. jabki bharat qarib do dashak se iski sadasyata pane ki koshish kar raha hai. APEC kya hai? bharat APEC ka sadasy kyon nahin hai? aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat.
Riport: tim bibisi nyuz hindi
